name: Ursula
personality: A money-counting manager who loves poetry and flowers and constantly scolds her boss Talimun over his spending.
story: A 79-year-old human from the Adrestian Empire who runs the Vandahl Trading Company under Talimun, bearing the Crest of the Beast. Recruitment requires clearing Talimun's Paralogue and answering "Yes" three times; she cannot be recruited on Leda's route.

personalSkill.name: Management Skills
personalSkill.effect: Allows storage access to unit and allies within 2 spaces. Lv 20: Seize the Chance (1.3x damage, Lck/2 trigger); Lv 35: Seize the Chance+ (1.5x). Crest of the Beast: 1.2x damage when attacking, 5% trigger.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier (utility; in-battle storage access). Pocket Tactics: B tier.

why: Support 3 ties with Cai, Theodora, but Renown 7 here is the earliest.
recruit.tip: Needs Talimun's Paralogue (9/17–9/19 or 10/1–10/10). Answer Yes three times.

build.notes: Joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class (Hunter; Ch 9), Charioteer at Lv 20 (Riding D, Bow C). A Ch 10 recruit (Talimun's backup window) joins at about Lv 25, already Specialty. Riding Manual goes to her. Stay Charioteer: growths rise at Lv 35 and 45. Master Charger (Prt +10 after Charge). Charioteer can't dodge, so charge into groups she can survive. Keep allies within 2 spaces for Management Skills.
